description: Grades an answer from any AI (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, another agent, or your own draft) about a listed company, fund or token issuer against the corporate actions feed (SEC filings) and the Tokenized Asset Map (issuers' own pages): every dividend amount and date, split ratio, acquirer, contract address and ISIN it states is marked right, wrong, out of date or not stated, with the source. Without an answer, returns the questions the AI answer check asks and the answer key, so you can confirm a figure before using it. Same code as https://iomarkets.tech/ai-check; it does not call any AI engine itself.

answer.description: The AI's answer as text, up to 40,000 characters (optional).

subject.description: A ticker, company name, CIK, FIGI, ISIN, token symbol or Asset Map id, such as NUE, BENJI or xstocks-aaplx.

name: check_ai_answer
title: Check what an AI said about a company, fund or token
